```{r Load}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext) # making genera names italic with element_markdown()
library(cowplot) # to put together panels
library(patchwork) # to put together panels


# pollen data
pollen_samples <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Pollen_samples_data_cleaned.csv')

# nest-level data summary
beehav_sum <- read_csv('Data/Behaviour/Behaviour_nest_summary_cleaned.csv')

# nest-level data all social statuses
beehav_full <- read_csv('Data/Behaviour/Behaviour_nest_full_cleaned.csv')

# pollen_samples and behaviour data
pollen_beehav <- read_csv('Data/Behaviour/Pollen_and_behaviour_cleaned.csv')

# pollen richness for individuals  
pollen_beehav_ind <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Pollen_richness_individuals_cleaned.csv')

# pollen richness for nests  
pollen_beehav_nest <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Pollen_richness_nests_cleaned.csv')

# pollen and abundance data
pollen_samples_abundance <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Pollen_samples_abundance_cleaned.csv')

# abundance data
abundance_for_fig <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Abundance_50m_for_figure_cleaned.csv') 
abundance_for_fig_not_collected <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Abundance_50m_for_figure_not_collected_cleaned.csv') 


# set theme
theme_set(theme_classic())


```

```{r Pollen_figures}

# make date labels for the figure
pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>%
  mutate(
    Date_label  = format(Date_pollen, "%b %d"),                    
    Date_label  = factor(Date_label, levels = format(sort(unique(Date_pollen)), "%b %d")))


# order by first date of bee sample
level_order <- pollen_samples %>%
  distinct(Site, Num_ID, Date_pollen) %>%
  slice_min(Date_pollen, by = Num_ID) %>%
  arrange(Site == 'KB', Date_pollen) %>%  # FALSE sorts before TRUE, so non-KB first
  pull(Num_ID)

pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>%
  mutate(Num_ID = factor(Num_ID, levels = level_order))

pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>%
  arrange(Num_ID, Date_pollen) %>%
  mutate(Slide_code = factor(Slide_code, levels = unique(Slide_code)))


# # take the order of bee IDs and divided them by 10s
# # used to create 5 graphs to put together
# order_1 <- pollen_samples %>% 
#   distinct(Num_ID) %>% 
#   slice(1:10)
# order_2 <- pollen_samples %>% 
#   distinct(Num_ID) %>% 
#   slice(11:20)
# order_3 <- pollen_samples %>% 
#   distinct(Num_ID) %>% 
#   slice(21:30)
# order_4 <- pollen_samples %>% 
#   distinct(Num_ID) %>% 
#   slice(31:39) # bump the first KB site to the next line
# order_5 <- pollen_samples %>% 
#   distinct(Num_ID) %>% 
#   slice(40:49)



# what's the order of the most collected pollen?
pollen_samples %>% 
  group_by(Subtype) %>% 
  summarise(count = sum(Count_scaled)) %>% 
  arrange(-count)
# top 10:
 # Ranunculus	5259 / 24897 = 21.1%			
 # Plantago	4004 / 24897 = 16.1%			
 # Asteraceae	3646 / 24897 = 14.6%			
 # Rubus				
 # Cichorieae				
 # Muehlenbeckia				
 # Lysimachia				
 # Unknown_1				
 # Brassicaceae				
 # Unknown_6

# bottom 10:
 # Rhododendron    
 # Poaceae           
 # Unknown_5          
 # Solanum            
 # Iridaceae          
 # Veronica           
 # Unknown_7          
 # Leycesteria       
 # Caryophyllaceae   
 # Corokia        

pollen_samples %>% 
  summarise(count = sum(Count_scaled))
# total pollen grains: 24897



## Make colours

# take inspo from this package
# library(paletteer)
# paletteer_d("ggthemes::Tableau_20")


specific_colours <- c(
  'Amaryllidaceae' = '#a34676', 
  'Asteraceae' = '#EA866C', # Asteraceae
  'Cichorieae' = '#E9BA31', # Asteraceae
  'Brassicaceae' = '#5682f0',
  'Caryophyllaceae' = '#449450',   ## RARE
  'Corokia' = '#96e0d8',           ## RARE
  'Iridaceae' = '#e199f7',         ## RARE
  'Leycesteria' = '#EB5D5A',       ## RARE
  'Lysimachia' = '#86BCB6',
  'Muehlenbeckia' = '#a6bfff',
  'Myrtaceae' = '#c0f0fa',
  'Plantago' = '#9ec716', # Plantaginaceae
  'Veronica' = '#d4e892', # Plantaginaceae ## RARE
  'Poaceae' = '#cf9b57',            ## RARE
  'Ranunculus' = '#f7e211',
  'Rhododendron' = '#6F8FAF',       ## RARE
  'Rosaceae' = '#f24180',   # Rosaceae
  'Pyracantha' = '#f57fa9', # Rosaceae
  'Rubus' = '#ffccde',      # Rosaceae
  'Solanum' = '#cacad9',           ## RARE 
  'Viburnum' = '#cbe4f5',
  'Unknown_1' = '#FFE7D1',
  'Unknown_2' = '#FBAF7A', 
  'Unknown_3' = '#F78334',
  'Unknown_4' = '#B96478',
  'Unknown_5' = '#8449B3',
  'Unknown_6' = '#B284D7', 
  'Unknown_7' = '#EDD9FC'
  )


## Text for legend

pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>% 
  mutate(Subtype_label = case_when(
    Subtype == 'Ranunculus' ~ '<i>Ranunculus</i> (Ranunculaceae)',
    Subtype == 'Rubus' ~ '<i>Rubus</i> (Rosaceae)',
    Subtype == 'Veronica' ~ '<i>Veronica</i> (Plantaginaceae)',
    Subtype == 'Cichorieae' ~ 'Cichorieae (Asteraceae)',
    Subtype == 'Corokia' ~ '<i>Corokia</i> (Argophyllaceae)',
    Subtype == 'Leycesteria' ~ '<i>Leycesteria</i> (Caprifoliaceae)',
    Subtype == 'Lysimachia' ~ '<i>Lysimachia</i> (Primulaceae)',
    Subtype == 'Muehlenbeckia' ~ '<i>Muehlenbeckia</i> (Polygonaceae)',    
    Subtype == 'Plantago' ~ '<i>Plantago</i> (Plantaginaceae)',
    Subtype == 'Pyracantha' ~ '<i>Pyracantha</i> (Rosaceae)',
    Subtype == 'Rhododendron' ~ '<i>Rhododendron</i> (Ericaceae)',
    Subtype == 'Solanum' ~ '<i>Solanum</i> (Solanaceae)',    
    Subtype == 'Viburnum' ~ '<i>Viburnum</i> (Adoxaceae)',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_1' ~ 'Type 1',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_2' ~ 'Type 2',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_3' ~ 'Type 3',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_4' ~ 'Type 4',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_5' ~ 'Type 5',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_6' ~ 'Type 6',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_7' ~ 'Type 7',
    TRUE ~ Subtype  # leave the rest as is
  ))


# choose order of legend
pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>%
  mutate(Subtype = factor(Subtype, levels = c(
    'Amaryllidaceae',
    'Asteraceae',
    'Cichorieae',
    'Brassicaceae',
    'Caryophyllaceae',
    'Corokia',
    'Iridaceae',
    'Leycesteria',
    'Lysimachia',
    'Muehlenbeckia',
    'Myrtaceae',
    'Plantago',
    'Veronica',
    'Poaceae',
    'Ranunculus',
    'Rhododendron',
    'Rosaceae',
    'Pyracantha',
    'Rubus',
    'Solanum',
    'Viburnum',
    'Unknown_1',
    'Unknown_2',
    'Unknown_3',
    'Unknown_4',
    'Unknown_5',
    'Unknown_6',
    'Unknown_7'
    )))


# plot with facat wrap

samples_fig <- pollen_samples %>%
  arrange(Num_ID, Date_pollen) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Slide_code, y = Count, fill = Subtype)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.8) + 
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Proportion of pollen sample") +
  facet_wrap(~ Num_ID, scales = "free_x", ncol = 7) +
 scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
   pollen_samples$Date_label[match(x, pollen_samples$Slide_code)]
 }) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = specific_colours,
  labels = pollen_samples %>% distinct(Subtype, Subtype_label) %>% deframe(),
  name = "Pollen type" # legend title
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.95, hjust = 1, size = 7, colour = "grey20"), # date label
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey60", hjust = 0),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20"), # make ticks thinner
    legend.text = element_markdown(), # makes italics from <i> </i>
    axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20"), # make lines thinner
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size=14, margin = margin(r = 12)), # size and placement of axes labels
    axis.title.x = element_text(size=14, vjust = -0.5)
    ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) + # breaks 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) # make legend one column instead of two

samples_fig

## Save
ggsave('Figures/Pollen_samples_fig.png', samples_fig, width = 8.4, height = 9, dpi = 300)


```

```{r Pollen_figures_Conference}

## show the social and solitary individuals


specific_colours_conf <- c(
  "Amaryllidaceae" = '#a34676', 
  "Asteraceae" = '#EA866C', # Asteraceae
  "Cichorieae" = '#E9BA31', # Asteraceae
  "Brassicaceae" = '#5682f0',
  "Caryophyllaceae" = '#449450',   ## RARE
  "Corokia" = '#96e0d8',           ## RARE
  "Iridaceae" = '#e199f7',         ## RARE
  "Leycesteria" = '#EB5D5A',       ## RARE
  "Lysimachia" = '#86BCB6',
  "Muehlenbeckia" = '#a6bfff',
  "Myrtaceae" = '#c0f0fa',
  "Plantago" = '#9ec716', # Plantaginaceae
  "Veronica" = '#d4e892', # Plantaginaceae ## RARE
  "Poaceae" = '#cf9b57',            ## RARE
  "Ranunculus" = '#f7e211',
  "Rhododendron" = '#6F8FAF',       ## RARE
  "Rosaceae" = '#f24180',   # Rosaceae
  "Pyracantha" = '#f57fa9', # Rosaceae
  "Rubus" = '#ffccde',      # Rosaceae
  "Solanum" = '#cacad9',           ## RARE 
  "Viburnum" = '#cbe4f5',
  "Unknown_1" = '#ffd0a6', # <-- changed just for the conference poster
  "Unknown_2" = '#FBAF7A', 
  "Unknown_3" = '#F78334',
  "Unknown_4" = '#B96478',
  "Unknown_5" = '#8449B3',
  "Unknown_6" = '#B284D7', 
  "Unknown_7" = '#EDD9FC'
  )

pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>% 
  mutate(Subtype_label_conf = case_when(
    Subtype == "Ranunculus" ~ "Ranunculaceae: <i>Ranunculus</i>",
    Subtype == "Rubus" ~ "Rosaceae: <i>Rubus</i>",
    Subtype == "Veronica" ~ "Plantaginaceae: <i>Veronica</i>",
    Subtype == "Cichorieae" ~ "Asteraceae: Cichorieae",
    Subtype == "Corokia" ~ "Argophyllaceae: <i>Corokia</i>",
    Subtype == "Leycesteria" ~ "Caprifoliaceae: <i>Leycesteria</i>",
    Subtype == "Lysimachia" ~ "Primulaceae: <i>Lysimachia</i>",
    Subtype == "Muehlenbeckia" ~ "Polygonaceae: <i>Muehlenbeckia</i>",    
    Subtype == "Plantago" ~ "Plantaginaceae: <i>Plantago</i>",
    Subtype == "Pyracantha" ~ "Rosaceae: <i>Pyracantha</i>",
    Subtype == "Rhododendron" ~ "Ericaceae: <i>Rhododendron</i>",
    Subtype == "Solanum" ~ "Solanaceae: <i>Solanum</i>",    
    Subtype == "Viburnum" ~ "Adoxaceae: <i>Viburnum</i>",
    Subtype == 'Unknown_1' ~ 'Type 1',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_2' ~ 'Type 2',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_3' ~ 'Type 3',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_4' ~ 'Type 4',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_5' ~ 'Type 5',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_6' ~ 'Type 6',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_7' ~ 'Type 7',
    TRUE ~ Subtype  # leave the rest as is
  ))


# make Subtype order grouped by Family
subtype_order <- pollen_samples %>%
  distinct(Family, Subtype) %>%
  arrange(Family, Subtype) %>%   # sorts Subtypes within each Family alphabetically
  pull(Subtype)

pollen_beehav <- pollen_beehav %>%
  mutate(Subtype = factor(Subtype, levels = subtype_order))

pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>%
  mutate(Subtype = factor(Subtype, levels = subtype_order))


# make date labels for the figure
pollen_beehav <- pollen_beehav %>%
  mutate(
    Date_label  = format(Date_pollen, "%b %d"),                    
    Date_label  = factor(Date_label, levels = format(sort(unique(Date_pollen)), "%b %d")))

# add column for Num ID
names <-  pollen_samples %>% select(Num_ID, Bee_ID)
names <- distinct(names)
pollen_beehav <- left_join(pollen_beehav, names)

# actually, change number ID drop the site
pollen_beehav <- pollen_beehav %>% mutate(Num_ID_number = str_extract(Num_ID, "(?<=\\.)\\d+"))

# order by first date of bee sample
level_order_2 <- pollen_beehav %>%
  distinct(Site, Nest, Num_ID_number, Date_pollen) %>%
  slice_min(Date_pollen, by = Num_ID_number) %>%
  arrange(Site == "KB", Date_pollen) %>%  # FALSE sorts before TRUE, so non-KB first
  pull(Num_ID_number)

pollen_beehav <- pollen_beehav %>%
  arrange(Num_ID_number, Date_pollen) %>%
  mutate(Slide_code = factor(Slide_code, levels = unique(Slide_code)))

# make a lookup table: Num_ID -> Nest
nest_lookup <- pollen_beehav %>%
  distinct(Num_ID_number, Nest) %>%
  deframe()

# change order of samples to be Nests
nest_order <- c("J00", "J16", "J18", "J26", "J32", "J42", "J50", "J51", "J54", "J57", "J58", "J65", "J67", "J71", "J75", "J80", "J87", "J91", "J92", "J100", "K8", "K11") # custom cause K8 shows up in the 80s

num_id_order <- pollen_beehav %>%
  distinct(Nest, Num_ID_number) %>%
  mutate(Nest = factor(Nest, levels = nest_order)) %>%  # forces custom nest order
  arrange(Nest, Num_ID_number) %>%
  pull(Num_ID_number)

pollen_beehav <- pollen_beehav %>%
  mutate(Num_ID_number = factor(Num_ID_number, levels = num_id_order))


# plot social individuals 
samples_fig_social_conf <- pollen_beehav %>%
  filter(Social_status_ever_con == 'social') %>%  
  arrange(Num_ID_number, Date_pollen) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Slide_code, y = Count_scaled, fill = Subtype)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.8) + 
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Proportion of pollen sample")  +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Num_ID_number, 
    scales = "free_x", 
    ncol = 10,
    labeller = as_labeller(function(id) paste0("**", nest_lookup[id], "**: ", id))
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
    pollen_samples$Date_label[match(x, pollen_samples$Slide_code)]
  }) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = specific_colours_conf,
  labels = pollen_samples %>% distinct(Subtype, Subtype_label_conf) %>% deframe(),
  name = "Pollen type"
  ) + 
  theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.95, hjust = 1, size = 8, colour = "grey20"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, colour = "grey20"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_markdown(size = 11, colour = "grey20", hjust = 0),  
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20"),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20"),
      axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 26, margin = margin(r = 12)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 26, vjust = -0.5),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1))


# plot solitary bees
samples_fig_solitary_conf <- pollen_beehav %>%
  filter(Social_status_ever_con == 'solitary') %>%  
  arrange(Num_ID_number, Date_pollen) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Slide_code, y = Count_scaled, fill = Subtype)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.8) + 
  labs(x = "Date", y = NULL) + 
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Num_ID_number, 
    scales = "free_x", 
    ncol = 20,
    labeller = as_labeller(function(id) paste0("**", nest_lookup[id], "**: ", id))
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
    pollen_samples$Date_label[match(x, pollen_samples$Slide_code)]
  }) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = specific_colours_conf,
  labels = pollen_samples %>% distinct(Subtype, Subtype_label_conf) %>% deframe(),
  name = "Pollen type"
  ) + 
  theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.95, hjust = 1, size = 8, colour = "grey20"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, colour = "grey20"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_markdown(size = 11, colour = "grey20", hjust = 0),  
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20"),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20"),
      axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 26, vjust = -0.5),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1))


samples_fig_social_conf
samples_fig_solitary_conf

## Save
ggsave('Figures/Pollen_social_fig_conference.png', samples_fig_social_conf, width = 6, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave('Figures/Pollen_solitary_fig_conference.png', samples_fig_solitary_conf, width = 15, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r Pollen_figures_2}


## Make a figure divided by social, solitary, and unknown social phenotypes 

# change J and K for A and B
pollen_beehav <- pollen_beehav %>%
  mutate(Nest = sub("^J", "A", Nest),
         Nest = sub("^K", "B", Nest))

# add social status and nest to unknown social status bees
columns_needed <- pollen_beehav %>% select(Nest, Slide_code, Subtype, Social_status_at_time_con)
pollen_samples <- left_join(pollen_samples, columns_needed)


# make nest A or B for unknown bees
pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>% mutate(Nest = ifelse(is.na(Nest) & Site == 'JAM', 'A',
                                                          ifelse(is.na(Nest) & Site == 'KB', 'B', Nest)))

# make social status unknown 
pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>% mutate(Social_status_at_time_con = ifelse(is.na(Social_status_at_time_con), 'unknown', Social_status_at_time_con))


# change number ID drop the site
pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>% mutate(Num_ID_number = str_extract(Num_ID, "(?<=\\.)\\d+"))

pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>%
   mutate(strip_label = paste0("**", Nest, "**: ", Num_ID_number))

# make custom order of samples because ordering by date doesnt work
bee_order_social <- c("15", "66", "67", "71", "70", "72", "77")
bee_order_solitary <- c("31", "21", "38", "82", "42", "47", "57", "46", "54", "13", "52", "63", "60", "66", "25", "67", "77", "40", "70", "7", "10")
bee_order_unknown <- c("32", "36", "2", "34", "51", "9", "43", "45", "62", "56", "49", "17", "64", "22", "85", "73", "74", "4", "6", "14", "8", "18", "15", "20", "26")

# divide the df by social phenotype
pollen_samples_social <- pollen_samples %>%
  filter(Social_status_at_time_con == 'social') 
pollen_samples_solitary <- pollen_samples %>%
  filter(Social_status_at_time_con == 'solitary') 
pollen_samples_unknown <- pollen_samples %>%
  filter(Social_status_at_time_con == 'unknown') 


panel_order <- pollen_samples_social %>%
  distinct(Num_ID_number, Nest) %>%
  mutate(
    Num_ID_number = as.character(Num_ID_number),
    custom_order = match(Num_ID_number, bee_order_social),
    strip_label = paste0("**", Nest, "**: ", Num_ID_number)
  ) %>%
  arrange(custom_order)
pollen_samples_social <- pollen_samples_social %>%
  mutate(
    strip_label = factor(
      strip_label,
      levels = panel_order$strip_label))

panel_order <- pollen_samples_solitary %>%
  distinct(Num_ID_number, Nest) %>%
  mutate(
    Num_ID_number = as.character(Num_ID_number),
    custom_order = match(Num_ID_number, bee_order_solitary),
    strip_label = paste0("**", Nest, "**: ", Num_ID_number)
  ) %>%
  arrange(custom_order)
pollen_samples_solitary <- pollen_samples_solitary %>%
  mutate(
    strip_label = factor(
      strip_label,
      levels = panel_order$strip_label))

panel_order <- pollen_samples_unknown %>%
  distinct(Num_ID_number, Nest) %>%
  mutate(
    Num_ID_number = as.character(Num_ID_number),
    custom_order = match(Num_ID_number, bee_order_unknown),
    strip_label = paste0("**", Nest, "**: ", Num_ID_number)
  ) %>%
  arrange(custom_order)
pollen_samples_unknown <- pollen_samples_unknown %>%
  mutate(
    strip_label = factor(
      strip_label,
      levels = panel_order$strip_label))


# plot bees with no social data
samples_fig_no_social_data <- pollen_samples_unknown %>%
  filter(Social_status_at_time_con == 'unknown') %>%  
  arrange(Num_ID_number, Date_pollen) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Slide_code, y = Count_scaled, fill = Subtype)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.8) + 
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + 
  facet_wrap(~ strip_label, scales = "free_x", ncol = 7) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
    pollen_samples$Date_label[match(x, pollen_samples$Slide_code)]
  }) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = specific_colours_conf,
  labels = pollen_samples %>% distinct(Subtype, Subtype_label_conf) %>% deframe(),
  name = "Pollen type"
  ) + 
  theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.95, hjust = 1, size = 9, colour = "grey20"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, colour = "grey20"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_markdown(size = 9, colour = "grey60", hjust = 0),  
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20"),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20"),
```

```{r Abundance_fig_pollen_collected}


## Abundance

# # do both sites have identical taxa? I only want one legend with all taxa
# JAM <- abundance_for_fig %>% 
#   filter(Site == 'JAM') %>% 
#   select(Subtype)
# KB <- abundance_for_fig %>% 
#   filter(Site == 'KB') %>% 
#   select(Subtype)
# anti_join(KB, JAM) # has rhododendron and muehlenbeckia
# anti_join(JAM, KB)


# jitter the lines becasue some overlap
pos <- position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.12)


# plot for JAM
abund_fig_JAM <- abundance_for_fig %>% 
  filter(Site == 'JAM') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Season, y = Abundance_for50, group = Subtype, colour = Subtype)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.07, height = 0.07) +
  geom_line(position = pos) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = specific_colours) +
  labs(x = '\n Site A', y = NULL) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(label = c('Mid season', 'Late season'))


# plot for KB
abund_fig_KB <- abundance_for_fig %>% 
  filter(Site == 'KB') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Season, y = Abundance_for50, group = Subtype, colour = Subtype)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.07, height = 0.07) +
  geom_line(position = pos) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = specific_colours) +
  labs(x = '\n Site B', y = NULL) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(label = c('Mid season', 'Late season'))

# order for the legend
abundance_for_fig <- abundance_for_fig %>%
  mutate(Subtype = factor(Subtype, levels = c(
    'Amaryllidaceae',
    'Asteraceae',
    'Cichorieae',
    'Brassicaceae',
    'Caryophyllaceae', 
    'Corokia',
    'Iridaceae',       
    'Leycesteria',     
    'Lysimachia',      
    'Muehlenbeckia',   
    'Myrtaceae',       
    'Plantago',  
    'Veronica',    
    'Poaceae',         
    'Ranunculus',   
    'Rhododendron',    
    'Rosaceae',
    'Pyracantha',
    'Rubus',
    'Solanum', 
    'Viburnum'
    )))

# text for the legend 
abundance_for_fig <- abundance_for_fig %>%
  mutate(Subtype_label = case_when(
    Subtype == "Ranunculus" ~ "<i>Ranunculus</i> (Ranunculaceae)",
    Subtype == "Rubus" ~ "<i>Rubus</i> (Rosaceae)",
    Subtype == "Veronica" ~ "<i>Veronica</i> (Plantaginaceae)",
    Subtype == "Cichorieae" ~ "Cichorieae (Asteraceae)",
    Subtype == "Corokia" ~ "<i>Corokia</i> (Argophyllaceae)",
    Subtype == "Leycesteria" ~ "<i>Leycesteria</i> (Caprifoliaceae)",
    Subtype == "Lysimachia" ~ "<i>Lysimachia</i> (Primulaceae)",
    Subtype == "Muehlenbeckia" ~ "<i>Muehlenbeckia</i> (Polygonaceae)",    
    Subtype == "Plantago" ~ "<i>Plantago</i> (Plantaginaceae)",
    Subtype == "Pyracantha" ~ "<i>Pyracantha</i> (Rosaceae)",
    Subtype == "Rhododendron" ~ "<i>Rhododendron</i> (Ericaceae)",
    Subtype == "Solanum" ~ "<i>Solanum</i> (Solanaceae)",    
    Subtype == "Viburnum" ~ "<i>Viburnum</i> (Adoxaceae)",
    Subtype == 'Unknown_1' ~ 'Type 1',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_2' ~ 'Type 2',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_3' ~ 'Type 3',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_4' ~ 'Type 4',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_5' ~ 'Type 5',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_6' ~ 'Type 6',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_7' ~ 'Type 7',
    TRUE ~ Subtype  # leave the rest as is
  ))


# I want a single legend with ALL taxa combined, so create a dummy plot to extract legend 
all_taxa <- abundance_for_fig %>% distinct(Subtype) %>% pull(Subtype)

dummy_plot <- data.frame(
  Subtype = all_taxa,
  x = 1,
  y = 1
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, colour = Subtype)) +  # keep Subtype here
  geom_point()  +
  scale_colour_manual(values = specific_colours, 
                      labels = abundance_for_fig %>% distinct(Subtype, Subtype_label) %>% deframe(),
                      drop = FALSE,
                      name = 'Pollen type') +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.justification = "top",
        legend.text = element_markdown())  # needed to render the italic HTML tags

# extract legend 
legend <- get_legend(dummy_plot)


## Combine figs

# combine, add letters and legend
abund_combined <- plot_grid(
  plot_grid(abund_fig_JAM, abund_fig_KB,
            ncol = 2, labels = c("a", "b"),
            label_fontface = "plain",  # not bold
            label_x = -0.03, # move letters slightly left 
            label_y = 1),          
  legend,
  ncol = 2,
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.4)) # legend width


# make axes labels
abund_left_label <- ggplot() +
  annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5, # x is left or right, y is up and down
           label = 'Abundance of plants collected',
           angle = 90,
           size = 4) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
abund_bottom_label <- ggplot() +
    annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
           label = 'Season',
           angle = 0,
           size = 4) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 110, 0, 10)
  )

# combine them into a single plot object
abund_combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(abund_left_label, abund_combined, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.05, 0.95))
# abund_combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(abund_combined, abund_bottom_label, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.09))
```

```{r Abundance_fig_plants_not_collected}
## Combine figs
```

```{r Behviour_figures}

# label by week

beehav_full <- beehav_full %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date_beehav)) %>% 
  mutate(Week_index = as.numeric(difftime(floor_date(Date_beehav, "week"),
                                     floor_date(min(Date_beehav), "week"),
                                     units = "weeks") + 1))

# remove duplicates within the same week if there are any by arranging "social" first, then removing dupes
beehav_sum_weekly <- beehav_full %>%
  group_by(Week_index, Nest) %>%
  arrange(desc(Num_females_same_day)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()


# plot nest socialty throughout the season 

# make sample size for figure
sample_size_beehav_full <- beehav_sum_weekly %>%
  count(Week_index)


# con
beehav_sum_weekly %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Week_index, fill = Social_status_con)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(y = "Percent") +
  geom_text(data = sample_size_beehav_full,
            aes(x = Week_index, y = 1.05,
                label = paste0(n)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#045b87", "#52c5ff"))



# max number of females in each nest 
# Conservative estimate
beehav_sum %>%
  filter(Num_females_same_day != 0) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Num_females_same_day, fill = Site)) +
  geom_bar(position = 'dodge') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#e65f55", "#edc647"))  +
  labs(y = 'Number of nests', x = 'Number of females')



# Number females over time in social nests conservative estimate
beehav_sum_weekly %>%
  filter(Nest == "J18" | Nest == "J100" | Nest == "J87" | Nest == "J91" | Nest == "J92" | Nest == "K13") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Week_index, y = Num_females_same_day, colour = Nest, fill = Nest)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  ylim(0, 4)


# plot total number of nest sociality
beehav_sum %>%
  filter(Num_females_same_day != 0) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Site, fill = Social_status_con)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#045b87", "#52c5ff")) +
  labs(fill = "Sociality", y = 'Number of nests')
```

```{r Richness_and_Sociality}


## Richness for nests and individuals 

# put solitary first
pollen_beehav_nest <- pollen_beehav_nest %>% 
  mutate(Social_status_at_time_con = factor(Social_status_at_time_con, 
                              levels = c("solitary", "social")))
pollen_beehav_ind <- pollen_beehav_ind %>% 
    mutate(Social_status_at_time_con = factor(Social_status_at_time_con, 
                              levels = c("solitary", "social")))

# remove duplicates for individuals (kept all samples for the analyses) but graphing average for the fig
pollen_beehav_ind <- pollen_beehav_ind %>%
  group_by(Bee_ID) %>%
  arrange(desc(Social_status_at_time_con == "social")) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()
# Social_status_at_time_con actually becomes social EVER
pollen_beehav_ind <- pollen_beehav_ind %>% rename(Social_status_ever_con = Social_status_at_time_con)
  

# richness per nest, compiled
richness_fig_nest <- pollen_beehav_nest %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Social_status_at_time_con, y = Richness_nest, fill = Social_status_at_time_con )) + 
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Social_status_at_time_con, colour = Social_status_at_time_con),
    alpha = 0.3,
    width = 0.4) +
  geom_dotplot(aes(fill = Social_status_at_time_con), binaxis = 'y', stackdir = 'center', color = NA, dotsize = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#EA866C", "#d9512e")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = alpha(c("#EA866C", "#d9512e"), 0.7)) +
  labs(x = '\n Nest', y = NULL) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(label = c('Solitary', 'Social')) +
  ylim(0, 7)

# richness per invidivual, average
richness_fig_ind <- pollen_beehav_ind %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Social_status_ever_con, y = Richness_ind_mean, fill = Social_status_ever_con )) + 
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Social_status_ever_con, colour = Social_status_ever_con),
    alpha = 0.3,
    width = 0.4) +
  geom_dotplot(aes(fill = Social_status_ever_con), binaxis = 'y', stackdir = 'center', color = NA, dotsize = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#EA866C", "#d9512e")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = alpha(c("#EA866C", "#d9512e"), 0.7)) + # "#cc7a7a", "#994545"
  labs(x = '\n Individual', y = NULL) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(label = c('Solitary', 'Social')) +
  ylim(0, 7)


# combine, add letters and legend
richness_combined <- plot_grid(
  plot_grid(richness_fig_ind, richness_fig_nest,
            ncol = 2, labels = c("a", "b"),
            label_fontface = "plain",  # not bold
            label_x = -0.03, # move letters slightly left 
            label_y = 1))


# make axes labels
richness_left_label <- ggplot() +
  annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
           label = 'Pollen richness',
           angle = 90,
           size = 4) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

#   )

# combine them into a single plot object
```

```{r Pollen_and_Sociality_figures}
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Proportion of pollen", title = "social nests") +
  facet_wrap(~ Bee_ID, scales = "free_x") 

# all samples of solitary nests
pollen_beehav %>% 
  filter(Social_status_at_time_con == "solitary") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Date_pollen, y = Count, fill = Family)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +  
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Proportion of pollen", title = "solitary nests") +
  facet_wrap(~ Bee_ID, scales = "free_x")
```
